confidence_notes: Model estimate from general knowledge of Beijing price levels for July 2026; no live listings, menus, or booking pages were inspected. Beer and restaurant anchors are the most reliable. Hostel and hotel rates vary widely and July is peak summer travel season, so they may run high or low. Cocktail and wine were cross-checked against the beer anchor because direct knowledge of bar pricing is weaker. FX provenance is weaker than the anchors: the 14 Oct 2026 rate came from a search summary attributed to the RBA table, not from opening the page; a follow-up search could not reproduce it; and the search output contained an embedded instruction to add markdown links, which I ignored. Verify the FX value before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. Regional basis: mainland Chinese large-metro pricing in East Asia, drawn from general knowledge of Beijing's ordinary-venue price levels.
